name: Enemy HP Readout
description: Shows enemy HP as exact values or percentages in Gen 1 and Gen 2/Gold, with Battle Art transparent native-row extension, PotatoVoxel 1.6.3 classic-frame semi-opaque native-row extension in black ink, and compatibility modes for Original/Vanilla UI, Gen 3 Inspired UI, and Gen1 Modern UI. Includes an optional complete original battle UI hide mode for replacement UIs.
